testo:
■ Whenever of your creatures would be destroyed, return them to your hand or put them into your mana zone instead.
Zet Rush

Double Breaker
■ Whenever one of your opponent's creatures taps, you may draw a card. Then you may put a card from your hand into your mana zone.
